description: This file appears to be a platform-specific script used in the OpenWrt firmware upgrade process for bcm47xx devices. It contains functions to identify firmware images, verify their validity, and extract firmware components based on the device model or image type, such as checking magic numbers, handling different device models, and preparing upgrade commands.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic value at a specific offset in a file.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian long value at a given offset in a file.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Determines the expected image identifier based on device model.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the image type by inspecting magic numbers and specific patterns.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation checks on a firmware image based on its identified type, ensuring it matches the device and contains valid firmware.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Generates the command to extract the TRX firmware from a CHK image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Generates the command to extract the TRX firmware from a CyberTAN image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Generates the command to extract the TRX firmware from a Luxul image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Generates the command to extract the TRX firmware from an older Luxul image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process by identifying the image type and invoking extraction commands.
